Precor does not make an "arc trainer" Cybcx makcs the 
arc trainer. 
Precor makes an AMT 885 (Adaptive Motion Trainer) 
https://www.leisurefitness.corn/Precor-AMT-885-with-Open-Stride-Adaptive-
Motion-Trainer-P1554.aspx 
The Precor AMT 885 is a commercial grade machine. It is an elliptical, 
stepper, treadmill and spin bike all in one machine. It has 
a 19" touch screen console (you can swipe like you do an 
Iphone) You can get internet and TV (BUT, this must be 
hard wired, no wifi) You can incline. It lists for 
$11,995.00 
Leisure Fitness has a 20% restocking fee. Return/Exchange must be done 
within 30 days. If we exchange the Precor you have now 
for the AMT they will work with you re the restocking 
fee. Once a machine is delivered it is now considered 
used and it voids the warranty. 
The machine is huge! it is 29" wide, 48" tall and the max turning radius is 
64". Merwin would need to make sure this machine can 
go up in the elevator and make any turns that are 
required. It is a 3 person job for delivery. Weighs 422 
lbs. Leisure Fitness has one in stock. 
Just FYI-Leisure Fitness does not carry Cybex. The Cybex "arc trainer" only 
has one motion where the AMT 885 has 4 motions. 
Please advise what you would like to do.
